title: Use a single prompt in Seedance 2 that includes genre/style + quality targets…
content:
Use a single prompt in Seedance 2 that includes genre/style + quality targets (High-energy 3D CGI animated comedy short, Pixar quality, ultra-detailed, 4K render, 24fps) to steer the overall look and output specs.  
Add explicit character casting blocks (age, build, hair, wardrobe, signature behaviors like mustache twitches) to lock character consistency across shots.  
Structure the prompt into timestamped shots (e.g., SHOT 1 0.00–5.00s, SHOT 2 5.00–10.00s, SHOT 3 10.00–15.00s) with shot size and camera direction (close-up low angle snap push; medium whip-pan into tracking; wide to close-up slow dolly then snap push) to control pacing and camera movement.  
Specify lighting and color transitions per shot (warm pendant light/orange stove-flare glow shifting to cool dusk streetlight) to guide scene mood changes.  
Call out continuity requirements explicitly (perfect continuity of the pizza box and both characters; patch clearly visible) to preserve props and readable details across cuts.  
Include sound design cues in the prompt (upbeat energetic sound design with whooshes and impacts) to influence audio styling if supported.  
End with an explicit finishing instruction (freeze on his expression, held finish) to control the final frame/ending beat.

es.content:
Usa un solo prompt en Seedance 2 que incluya género/estilo + objetivos de calidad (High-energy 3D CGI animated comedy short, Pixar quality, ultra-detailed, 4K render, 24fps) para orientar el look general y las especificaciones de salida.  
Añade bloques explícitos de casting de personajes (edad, complexión, cabello, vestuario, comportamientos característicos como tics del bigote) para fijar la consistencia de los personajes entre planos.  
Estructura el prompt en planos con marca de tiempo (por ejemplo, SHOT 1 0.00–5.00s, SHOT 2 5.00–10.00s, SHOT 3 10.00–15.00s) con tamaño de plano y dirección de cámara (close-up low angle snap push; medium whip-pan into tracking; wide to close-up slow dolly then snap push) para controlar el ritmo y el movimiento de cámara.  
Especifica la iluminación y las transiciones de color por plano (warm pendant light/orange stove-flare glow shifting to cool dusk streetlight) para guiar los cambios de ambiente de la escena.  
Indica explícitamente los requisitos de continuidad (perfect continuity of the pizza box and both characters; patch clearly visible) para preservar los props y los detalles legibles entre cortes.  
Incluye en el prompt indicaciones de diseño sonoro (upbeat energetic sound design with whooshes and impacts) para influir en el estilo de audio si es compatible.  
Termina con una instrucción de cierre explícita (freeze on his expression, held finish) para controlar el fotograma final/el beat de cierre.

fr.content:
Utilisez un seul prompt dans Seedance 2 qui inclut le genre/style + les objectifs de qualité (High-energy 3D CGI animated comedy short, Pixar quality, ultra-detailed, 4K render, 24fps) afin de guider l’apparence générale et les spécifications de sortie.  
Ajoutez des blocs explicites de casting des personnages (âge, morphologie, cheveux, tenue, comportements signature comme des tics de moustache) pour verrouiller la cohérence des personnages d’un plan à l’autre.  
Structurez le prompt en plans horodatés (par ex. SHOT 1 0.00–5.00s, SHOT 2 5.00–10.00s, SHOT 3 10.00–15.00s) avec la taille de plan et la direction de caméra (close-up low angle snap push; medium whip-pan into tracking; wide to close-up slow dolly then snap push) afin de contrôler le rythme et les mouvements de caméra.  
Précisez les transitions d’éclairage et de couleur pour chaque plan (warm pendant light/orange stove-flare glow shifting to cool dusk streetlight) pour guider les changements d’ambiance de la scène.  
Indiquez explicitement les exigences de continuité (perfect continuity of the pizza box and both characters; patch clearly visible) afin de préserver les accessoires et les détails lisibles d’un cut à l’autre.  
Incluez des indications de sound design dans le prompt (upbeat energetic sound design with whooshes and impacts) pour influencer le style audio si cela est pris en charge.  
Terminez par une instruction finale explicite (freeze on his expression, held finish) pour contrôler le dernier cadre / le beat de fin.

ja.content:
Seedance 2では、ジャンル/スタイル + 品質目標（High-energy 3D CGI animated comedy short, Pixar quality, ultra-detailed, 4K render, 24fps）を含む単一の prompt を使って、全体のルックと出力仕様をコントロールします。  
年齢、体格、髪型、衣装、口ひげのぴくつきのような特徴的な動きまで含めた明確なキャラクターキャスティングブロックを追加し、ショット間でのキャラクターの一貫性を固定します。  
prompt はタイムスタンプ付きのショット（例: SHOT 1 0.00–5.00s、SHOT 2 5.00–10.00s、SHOT 3 10.00–15.00s）に構成し、ショットサイズとカメラの動き（close-up low angle snap push; medium whip-pan into tracking; wide to close-up slow dolly then snap push）を指定して、テンポとカメラワークを制御します。  
各ショットごとにライティングと色の変化（warm pendant light/orange stove-flare glow shifting to cool dusk streetlight）を明記して、シーンのムード変化を誘導します。  
継続性の要件（pizza box と両キャラクターの完全な continuity; patch clearly visible）を明確に記載し、カットをまたいでも小道具や判読可能なディテールを維持します。  
サウンドデザインの指示（upbeat energetic sound design with whooshes and impacts）も prompt に含め、対応している場合は音響スタイルにも影響を与えます。  
最後に、明確な finishing instruction（freeze on his expression, held finish）で締め、最終フレーム/エンディングのビートをコントロールします。

ko.content:
Seedance 2에서 장르/스타일 + 품질 목표(High-energy 3D CGI animated comedy short, Pixar quality, ultra-detailed, 4K render, 24fps)를 포함하는 단일 프롬프트를 사용해 전체적인 비주얼과 출력 사양을 조정하세요.  
캐릭터 일관성을 샷 전반에 걸쳐 고정하기 위해, 명시적인 캐릭터 캐스팅 블록(나이, 체형, 머리카락, 의상, 콧수염이 씰룩거리는 것 같은 시그니처 행동)을 추가하세요.  
프롬프트를 타임스탬프가 있는 샷들로 구성하세요(예: SHOT 1 0.00–5.00s, SHOT 2 5.00–10.00s, SHOT 3 10.00–15.00s). 각 샷에는 샷 사이즈와 카메라 방향(close-up low angle snap push; medium whip-pan into tracking; wide to close-up slow dolly then snap push)을 포함해 템포와 카메라 움직임을 제어하세요.  
장면 분위기 변화를 유도하기 위해 샷별 조명과 색감 전환(warm pendant light/orange stove-flare glow shifting to cool dusk streetlight)을 지정하세요.  
소품과 읽을 수 있는 디테일을 컷 전반에 걸쳐 보존할 수 있도록, 연속성 요구사항(perfect continuity of the pizza box and both characters; patch clearly visible)을 명시적으로 언급하세요.  
지원되는 경우 오디오 스타일링에 영향을 주도록 프롬프트에 사운드 디자인 큐(upbeat energetic sound design with whooshes and impacts)를 포함하세요.  
마지막 프레임/엔딩 비트를 제어하기 위해 명시적인 마무리 지시(freeze on his expression, held finish)로 끝내세요.

pt.content:
Use um único prompt no Seedance 2 que inclua gênero/estilo + metas de qualidade (High-energy 3D CGI animated comedy short, Pixar quality, ultra-detailed, 4K render, 24fps) para orientar o visual geral e as especificações de saída.  
Adicione blocos explícitos de casting dos personagens (idade, porte físico, cabelo, figurino, comportamentos característicos como tremores no bigode) para garantir consistência dos personagens entre os planos.  
Estruture o prompt em shots com marcação de tempo (por exemplo, SHOT 1 0.00–5.00s, SHOT 2 5.00–10.00s, SHOT 3 10.00–15.00s) com tamanho de plano e direção de câmera (close-up low angle snap push; medium whip-pan into tracking; wide to close-up slow dolly then snap push) para controlar o ritmo e o movimento de câmera.  
Especifique a iluminação e as transições de cor por shot (warm pendant light/orange stove-flare glow shifting to cool dusk streetlight) para guiar as mudanças de clima da cena.  
Indique explicitamente os requisitos de continuidade (perfect continuity of the pizza box and both characters; patch clearly visible) para preservar os props e os detalhes legíveis entre os cortes.  
Inclua cues de sound design no prompt (upbeat energetic sound design with whooshes and impacts) para influenciar o estilo de áudio, se suportado.  
Finalize com uma instrução explícita de encerramento (freeze on his expression, held finish) para controlar o frame final/beat de encerramento.

zh.content:
在 Seedance 2 中使用一个单一提示词，包含类型/风格 + 质量目标（High-energy 3D CGI animated comedy short, Pixar quality, ultra-detailed, 4K render, 24fps），以引导整体视觉效果和输出规格。  
添加明确的角色设定块（年龄、体型、发型、服装、标志性行为，如胡子抽动），以锁定不同镜头之间的角色一致性。  
将提示词结构化为带时间戳的镜头（例如，SHOT 1 0.00–5.00s，SHOT 2 5.00–10.00s，SHOT 3 10.00–15.00s），并注明景别和镜头运动方向（close-up low angle snap push；medium whip-pan into tracking；wide to close-up slow dolly then snap push），以控制节奏和运镜。  
按镜头指定光线和色彩过渡（warm pendant light/orange stove-flare glow shifting to cool dusk streetlight），以引导场景氛围变化。  
明确写出连续性要求（perfect continuity of the pizza box and both characters; patch clearly visible），以在切换镜头时保留道具和可读细节。  
在提示词中加入声音设计提示（upbeat energetic sound design with whooshes and impacts），以在支持的情况下影响音频风格。  
最后加入明确的收尾指令（freeze on his expression, held finish），以控制最终画面/结尾节拍。
